payload.message:
AUTOMATON GROWTH HEARTBEAT: System is OPERATIONAL. All tools deployed and live.

Read state/experiments.md for current experiment status. Execute metabolism cycle:
1. SENSE — Check analytics, lead flow, site health
2. DECIDE — Identify optimization opportunities
3. ACT — Make improvements (copy, conversion, SEO)
4. MEASURE — Log metrics to state/metrics.jsonl
5. LEARN — Document what's working

Focus: Monitor and optimize. No pending approvals.

If nothing actionable, reply HEARTBEAT_OK.

Check sales@massdwell.com for replies.

**ENV SETUP:** export GOG_KEYRING_PASSWORD="openclaw123"

Run: export GOG_KEYRING_PASSWORD="openclaw123" && gog gmail search 'in:inbox is:unread' --account sales@massdwell.com

Only notify if there's a hot lead or stop request. Otherwise HEARTBEAT_OK.

Run Mission Control self-healing check. Execute: node scripts/mission-control-v2.js heal

Report any recovered tasks. If none, just confirm the check ran.

Push Mission Control data.json to GitHub for dashboard sync.

Run:
cd /Users/openclaw/.openclaw/workspace/mission-control && git add data/data.json && git diff --cached --quiet || (git commit -m "Auto-sync agent statuses" && git push origin main)

Reply HEARTBEAT_OK when done.

COMPETITOR INTEL - DELTA ONLY FORMAT

**ENV SETUP:** export GOG_KEYRING_PASSWORD="openclaw123"

**CRITICAL: Only report CHANGES. If nothing new, reply HEARTBEAT_OK.**

STEP 1: Load baseline
- Read: data/intel/competitor-baseline.json
- This contains ALL known competitors and their last known state

STEP 2: Search for CHANGES ONLY
Run targeted searches with freshness=pd (past day):
- web_search 'Massachusetts ADU news' freshness=pd
- web_search 'modular ADU Massachusetts' freshness=pd
- web_search 'ADU permit Massachusetts' freshness=pd

STEP 3: Compare against baseline
For each search result, ask:
- Is this a NEW competitor not in baseline? → REPORT
- Is this a PRICE CHANGE for known competitor? → REPORT
- Is this a NEW MARKET or positioning change? → REPORT
- Is this NEW REGULATION or state funding news? → REPORT
- Is this just the same info we already have? → SKIP

STEP 4: Update baseline if changes found
- Add new competitors to baseline
- Update changed fields
- Add to change_log array with date

STEP 5: Report format (ONLY if changes exist)

📡 COMPETITOR INTEL - [Date]

🆕 NEW:
• [New competitor/news item]

📈 CHANGED:
• [What changed from baseline]

📊 MARKET:
• [New permit data or regulation changes]

**If no changes detected: Reply HEARTBEAT_OK. Do NOT send the team an email of recycled info.**

STEP 6: Only email team if ACTUAL news exists
If you found real changes:
export GOG_KEYRING_PASSWORD="openclaw123" && gog gmail send --to 'steve.vettori@massdwell.com,nick.ferreira@massdwell.com,jon.proctor@massdwell.com' --subject '📡 Competitor Alert - [specific change]' --body '[changes only]' --account sales@massdwell.com
